name: 07076 · Scotch Plains, NJ
findings: ZIP 07076 (Scotch Plains) has 110 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07076 (Scotch Plains) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07076 (Scotch Plains) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
